skill.name: conversion-copywriting

content.value_statement: Marketing pages often sound generic and make claims that cannot be verified. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce focused copy grounded in research.
actual_capabilities: Defines homepage, services page, and about page section structures.
Applies conversational, professional, or friendly voice guidance.
Replaces jargon with simpler alternatives listed in the skill.
Checks copy claims against approved business and customer evidence.
Produces meta title, meta description, page sections, and verification summary.
limitations: Does not collect customer research, competitor data, or licensing data by itself.
Does not guarantee legal or regulatory compliance for regulated industries.
Requires source evidence before making credentials, statistics, or customer claims.
Does not include executable code or direct integration with the referenced engine.

use_cases.title: Create a Service Homepage
use_cases.description: Build a homepage draft with customer language, benefits, proof, process steps, FAQ, and a clear call to action.

use_cases.title: Rewrite Client Service Pages
use_cases.description: Turn a plain service page into structured copy that explains the offer and marks claims for evidence review.

use_cases.title: Prepare Launch Copy
use_cases.description: Draft landing page sections for a new offer using proof points, customer concerns, and simple language.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Homepage
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new homepage draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create homepage copy for [business] serving [audience]. Use the skill structure, avoid banned phrases, and mark claims that need evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite a Services Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for improving existing service copy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this services page for [target customer]. Keep verified facts, simplify jargon, and organize the page into hero, services, proof, process, and CTA sections.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Verification Pass
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for claim checking before publication.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page copy against the provided customer quotes, licenses, credentials, and business facts. List unsupported claims and suggest safer replacements.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Multi-Page Copy Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a campaign or site refresh.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create homepage, about page, and services page copy for [business]. Use the same voice, reuse only verified proof, and provide a verification summary for each page.

output_examples.input: Homepage for a local cleaning company with verified testimonials.
output_examples.output: A homepage plan with a customer-focused headline, pain points, benefits, testimonials, process steps, FAQ, and a final call to action.

output_examples.input: Services page rewrite for a professional firm with approved credentials.
output_examples.output: A revised page with a clear offer, service details, proof sections, simple language, and notes for each claim that needs verification.

output_examples.input: Draft launch copy for a new service without customer quotes yet.
output_examples.output: A cautious draft that avoids unsupported claims, uses audience problems, and highlights where customer quotes or proof should be added.

best_practices: Provide real customer quotes and approved proof before drafting.
Give the target audience, offer, location, and desired conversion action.
Ask for a verification pass before publishing or handing copy to a client.
anti_patterns: Requesting awards, licenses, statistics, or results without evidence.
Using the skill to copy competitor language or imitate protected brand messaging.
Treating generated copy as final without human review and source checks.

faq.question: Can this skill write full landing pages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft structured landing pages when you provide the offer, audience, proof, and conversion goal.

faq.question: Does it create customer research?
faq.answer: No. It uses customer quotes and research you provide. It should not invent voice of customer evidence.

faq.question: Can it help with regulated industries?
faq.answer: Yes, but it needs strict evidence and human review. Legal, medical, and financial claims require extra care.

faq.question: What makes the copy different from a template?
faq.answer: The skill requires real customer language, verified claims, and page sections matched to the business goal.

faq.question: Can it rewrite existing copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can simplify language, improve structure, and mark unsupported claims for review.

faq.question: Does it publish or edit website files directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides copy and verification guidance. Publishing still depends on your website workflow.
